description: Use when forging Kerberos tickets on an authorized Active Directory engagement after recovering the krbtgt account hash. Covers extracting the krbtgt NTLM hash with secretsdump.py from impacket 0.12.0, forging golden tickets with mimikatz 2.2.0 kerberos::golden and impacket ticketer.py, injecting them with /ptt or KRB5CCNAME, and the related silver ticket variant with Rubeus 2.x. Use when you hold Domain Admin equivalent rights and need persistent, controllable domain access for the rest of the test, or when a CTF or lab asks for ticket forging.
